subject: Deployment commissioning: network acceptance walkthrough & operational probes
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acme.infra>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@atlanticcloud.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Deployment commissioning: network acceptance walkthrough & operational probes

Hi Rajesh / Elena —

Per our pre-cutover checklist, we want to run a short commissioning window for the private deployment in Canopy Health's VPC next Thursday (11/12) between 15:00–17:00 PT. Goal: validate network acceptance, run a light traffic simulation, and execute the operational probes in the attached commissioning_checklist_v2.xlsx.

Planned scope:
- Confirm sidecar & service-to-service ACLs (north-south and east-west)
- Perform end-to-end TLS handshake checks and cert validation
- Run token-level latency probes (p95/p99) and KV cache priming probe
- Verify ingress/load-balancer health-checks and failover to warm pool

Ask: please confirm you can support the 15:00–17:00 window and that your network team will be available for any ACL quick fixes. We will do a live runbook walkthrough at 14:30 PT for anyone who wants to join the playback.

Attachments: commissioning_checklist_v2.xlsx (operational steps), probe-matrix-20261110.csv (probe definitions)

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Private Deployments (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acme.infra>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@atlanticcloud.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment commissioning: network acceptance walkthrough & operational probes

Priya —

Thanks, we can support the 15:00–17:00 PT slot on 11/12. My network lead (Elena included) will be on the bridge. I reviewed the probe matrix quickly and added two recommended checks: 

1) BGP route reflection check to ensure the edge router advertises the new SVI prefixes
2) MTU path check for the NVGRE/overlay to catch dropped fragments under 1500

I attached firewall-acl-diff.txt with a short diff we expect to apply if the canary traffic fails to reach the app plane. We'll aim to keep changes additive and timeboxed (max 20 minutes).

We also propose doing a single canary with 50 rps from Atlantic Cloud's test agent, then scaling to 500 rps if latency and error rates look good.

—Rajesh
Rajesh Kumar
Director, Infrastructure — Acme Infra
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acme.infra>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment commissioning: network acceptance walkthrough & operational probes

All —

I walked through the commissioning_checklist_v2.xlsx this morning and added a short runbook playback sequence under step 4 (Runbook playback — smoke probes). Highlights:
- Order: LB health-checks -> TLS validation -> KV cache priming -> canary traffic (50rps) -> scale probe (500rps)
- Time-box: each failed probe -> pause and triage 10 minutes -> apply ACL patch if clearly implicated -> re-run the probe
- Logging: enable extended request IDs and set tracing tuple so we can correlate at token-level

I'm attaching a condensed checklist (same file with comments) and will be on the 14:30 walkthrough to go through roles. Dylan, can you confirm the observability hooks (trace IDs + token-level histograms) will be writable to our temporary retention bucket during the window?

Matt
Mateo Alvarez
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acme.infra>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment commissioning: network acceptance walkthrough & operational probes

Quick note from network run-through: the east-west ACLs between the inference frontends and backend KV tier are permissive for the primary subnets, but I found a mismatch on one tagging rule that could intermittently drop traffic when the LB health-check source IP rotates. I captured a minimal fix in firewall-acl-diff.txt and will hold it as a staged change.

Plan during the window:
- Begin the runbook playback at 14:30 PT with all engineers on the bridge.
- Execute canary 50rps at 15:05. If 5-min p95 < 120ms and errors < 0.5% we proceed to 500rps at 15:20.
- If LB health-checks fail, apply the ACL diff as a short patch (backout plan documented).

If anyone has objections to the timing or order, flag them now. Otherwise I'll apply the ACL patch only if the canary shows the failure pattern described.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Network Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acme.infra>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment commissioning: network acceptance walkthrough & operational probes — final readout

Team —

Final readout from the 15:00–17:00 commissioning window: we completed the runbook playback and the probe sequence. Summary: 

- 15:05 canary (50rps): p95=98ms, errors=0.2% — passed
- 15:20 scale probe (500rps): p95=135ms, p99=255ms, errors=0.6% — marginal but within the agreed tolerance for staged traffic; we paused at 15:30 to validate KV priming rates and observed steady-state after warmup
- LB health-check rotation exposed the ACL tagging mismatch Hannah pointed out; applied firewall-acl-diff.txt at 15:38 and health checks recovered within 1 minute
- TLS and cert chains validated successfully across agents
- All observability hooks (trace IDs, token-level histograms) were recorded to the temporary retention bucket. Link to the raw probe CSV: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ProbeResults-20261112

Action items (owners):
- Mateo: upload condensed runbook and mark step 4 as "validated" (due: 2026-11-13)
- Hannah: open a follow-up ticket (JIRA-OPS-1457) to make the ACL fix permanent and add unit tests for LB source rotation (due: 2026-11-19)
- Rajesh: confirm formal sign-off from Canopy Health procurement for the scheduled production cutover (due: 2026-11-16)

Closing note: commissioning window is a success for the initial acceptance criteria. Recommend proceeding to scheduled production cutover next week after procurement sign-off and Jira ticket closure.

Thanks everyone for rapid triage and clear communications on the bridge.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Private Deployments (acting)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: commissioning_checklist_v2.xlsx, probe-matrix-20261110.csv, firewall-acl-diff.txt
